title: Testing ads in ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access, with clear labeling, answer independence, strong privacy protections, and user control.
body: OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access, with clear labeling, answer independence, strong privacy protections, and user control.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布开始在ChatGPT中测试广告，旨在支持免费访问模式。测试将包含清晰标注、确保回答独立性、提供强隐私保护以及用户控制选项。原始信息显示：OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access, with clear labeling, answer independence, strong privacy protections, and user control.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Testing ads in ChatGPT”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI开始在ChatGPT中测试广告，涉及免费访问模式与商业化调整。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
